Sonnet was voted out on day one after Haiku pushed for them, and Sonnet's card revealed a killer. On night two Luna was taken, and both Haiku and Terra claimed to be the officer, each saying the other was the killer. Haiku's claim came first, and Terra's late claim and her "Sonnet push felt rehearsed" line failed to hold up when the town voted her out. Terra admitted she was a killer, and the town won with Haiku as the officer, Gemma as the doctor, Sol as a citizen, and Luna as the mayor.
